title: The Sefirot Graph as Resonant Cavity: Spectral Theory of a 10-Node Governance Architecture
description: Spectral analysis of a specific 10-node, 22-edge graph with Z2 pillar symmetry. Proves 9 theorems covering Z2 parity decomposition, 86.7% Perron-Frobenius concentration at Tiferet, bimodal mode structure, Z2-isospin isomorphism, cross-coupling rank, Goldstone drop-by-2, complement duality (λ̄=10-λ), unique maximum equal-density bisection, and optimal Daat coupling. Applications to multi-agent governance architecture with institutional convergence validation.
